responsibility: Implements gm2’s directory search-path list and filename resolution logic. It maintains a linked `PathList`, supports appending and concatenating path segments, normalizes directory separators when forming candidate paths, probes the filesystem with `Exists`, and returns the first matching full pathname, supplying the concrete search-path machinery used by module and include lookup code.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the concrete implementation of DynamicPath: it defines PathList as a linked structure with tail pointers, appends separators with AddDir, and performs Exists-based search across candidate directories. Unlike DynamicPath.def, it contains the actual path-list storage and filename-resolution algorithm.
